results.title: PBA great PJ Simon, the ‘Scoring Apostle,’ dies at 46
results.content: Philippine basketball mourns the sudden passing of former PBA star PJ Simon, who died after collapsing during a game

results.title: 1 in 8 Filipino students were vape users in 2024 – DOH
results.content: (1st UPDATE) Some users of e-cigarettes in the Philippines were only 7 years old when they started vaping, the 2024 Global Tobacco Survey finds
